repo.name: NESTNOTE F-Droid Repo
repo.description: F-Droid repository for NESTNOTE, a local-first Android notes app.

apps.description:
NESTNOTE is a local-first Android note-taking app built with Kotlin,
Jetpack Compose, and Material 3.

Organize notes with categories, colours, pinning, archiving, search, sorting,
checklists, bullet lists, writing statistics, and light or dark themes. Use
the focused note editor with Markdown formatting and preview, an inline
format rail for bold, italic, strikethrough, code, lists, quotes and
headings, and word-count tools.

Record voice notes directly in the Note editor, review recordings before
attaching them, preview and rename clips, import audio files up to 100 MiB,
or opt in to importing dialer call recordings from a folder you choose.
Imported recordings are encrypted on-device and the recordings screen is
protected by the Private Vault password with optional fingerprint unlock.
Multiple audio attachments appear as independent inline playback cards with
play/pause, seeking, progress, elapsed time, and duration. Playback stays
inside the note rather than opening a separate player or dialog.

Notes are stored locally with encrypted payloads using AES-GCM and Android
Keystore. NESTNOTE has no account or cloud sync. Portable note transfer uses password-protected `.nestnote` archives with AES-GCM encryption. Private Vault notes and audio attachments are excluded from portable archives.

Project website and release downloads are available from the project
repository and GitHub Releases.
apps.summary: Local-first encrypted notes with Markdown and voice attachments.
